title: Former TAMIU Professor Accused of Soliciting a Minor Online
excerpt: A former Texas A&M International University professor is accused of soliciting a minor online for sexual conduct, according to KGNS. Thomas Robert Brown was arrested by San Antonio police on Nov. 7.
content:
A former Texas A&M International University professor is accused of soliciting a minor online for sexual conduct, according to KGNS.

Jail records show Thomas Robert Brown was arrested by San Antonio police on Nov. 7 and booked into the Bexar County Jail, KGNS reported.

The university has confirmed that Brown no longer works at TAMIU. The university told KGNS it will cooperate with investigating authorities.

KGNS asked the university when Brown's employment ended, whether he was still working there on Nov. 7, and why he left. A university spokesperson said the university had no additional information.

Brown is accused of soliciting a minor online. He has not been convicted of any charge in this case, and he is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 19, 2026.
